decisions.reason: A certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line close to the core offer costs little to hold, and the absence of negative evidence gives no reason to abandon the option.
The marine box cooler line showed strong market share signals, so the option has largely paid off and warrants continued commitment.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line at low holding cost, so keeping it open remains sensible.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established capabilities with low holding costs, and there is no evidence that its value cannot be realized.
Finned tubes are a shared component for the air cooler business, so keeping them is cheap and strategically useful.
Enhanced tubes support efficiency gains across the portfolio at low marginal cost, so abandoning the option is not justified.
